Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+0416, which you can use as Ж in HTML, \0416 in CSS, or type with Alt+1046 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+0416 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape Ж or the hex escape Ж.

How to type cyrillic capital letter zhe on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 4 6 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 1046.
  4. Release Alt. The Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe character (Ж) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type cyrillic capital letter zhe on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe" and click the character to insert it.

How to use cyrillic capital letter zhe in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\0416"; ()
  • Python: \u0416 or chr(0x416)
  • JavaScript: \u0416 or String.fromCodePoint(0x416)
  • JSON: "\u0416"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for Ж?

No legacy Alt code exists for Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+0416 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type Ж without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Ж, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+1046 not work?

Alt+1046 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe?

The Unicode codepoint for Cyrillic Capital Letter Zhe is U+0416. You can use this value in HTML as Ж, in CSS as \0416, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Ж on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+0416, then click it.
